newsitem.title: USA: Interstate buys Arlington Dallas Marriott.
newsitem.headline: Interstate buys Arlington Dallas Marriott.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co (NYSE: said Friday that it has acquired the Arlington Dallas Marriott in Arlington, Texas, for $44.3 million from Amstar/First Capital Joint Venture.
The Arlington Dallas Marriott is a 310-room full-service, upscale hotel located midway between Dallas and Fort Worth, adjacent to the Arlington Convention Center.

The newly-renovated hotel has about 17,000 square feet of meeting space with an additional 7,000 square feet of outdoor space available, a multi-purpose restaurant, outdoor swimming pool, health club and business center.
Interstate Hotels, which has been managing the property since 1992, said it is considering plans for a guest room expansion.
About $1.0 million has been allocated for capital expenditures.
